sql: select w.contact_name, i.unit, w.bot_enabled, w.bot_step, l.status as lead_status, l.origem, w.created_at, (select jsonb_object_agg(coalesce(src,'(sem origem)'), n) from (select m.metadata->>'source' src, count(*) n from wapi_messages m where m.conversation_id = w.id and m.from_me group by 1) s) as quem_escreveu from wapi_conversations w left join wapi_instances i on i.id = w.instance_id left join campaign_leads l on l.id = w.lead_id where w.id = '7b3143e0-4ad6-44ac-a9ef-077192e2745d'
